source.description: Harness source; determines the file format and the fidelity class.

filename.description: Archived file name as stored under <archive>/<source>/.

harness.description: Optional format disambiguator for sources with multiple layouts (e.g. kimi wire vs context).

target_chars.description: Target chunk size in characters of rendered text (~20-40k tokens).

boundary_overlap_turns.description: Turns carried over at chunk boundaries for span continuity; overlap is a review-layer concern, never a duplication in the chunk map.
